# COQ_GEN — `apps/desktop/` consolidated UI (Variation F, Phase 1.5)

Single consolidated drop-in of the entire design-lane UI: everything the three
incremental packs delivered, merged into one `apps/desktop/` tree against the
current `main` contract. Commit this from **Claude Code** (the design lane's
GitHub access is read-only).

## Apply

```bash
git checkout main && git pull
git checkout -b claude/design-phase1.5
# copy this apps/desktop/** OVER the repo's apps/desktop/**
#   …but DO NOT overwrite src/types/  (engine-owned, generated by make gen-types)
make gen-types                                   # regenerate src/types/{api.d.ts,models.ts}
cd apps/desktop && npm install && npm run build  # tsc + vite build (DoD gate)
git add -A && git commit -m "design: Phase 1.5 UI — Variation F, 9 views, Templates + Document Generator"
git push -u origin claude/design-phase1.5        # open draft PR into main
```

> **`src/types/` is intentionally NOT in this pack.** `models.ts` + `api.d.ts`
> are engine-owned. Every view imports from `../types/models`; after
> `make gen-types` those imports resolve against the generated shapes.

## Tree

```
apps/desktop/
  package.json  tsconfig*.json  vite.config.ts  index.html
  src/
    main.tsx  App.tsx  AppShell.tsx
    styles/tokens.css          Variation F — navy #1B3A5C / gold #C9A227 / slate
    styles/global.css          tokens + IBM Plex + resets + focus-visible
    components/                Button Badge Field(Input/Select/Textarea) DataTable DocumentCard + index
    api/
      client.ts                live reads + ingest()       (Contract C)
      documents.ts             templates LIVE + generator preview/issue (@provisional mocks)
      index.ts                 barrel (re-exports both)
    views/
      status.ts                verdict/status → Badge mapping (SOP vocab)
      Dashboard.tsx            DashboardSummary KPIs + DocumentRef + BatchSummary
      IngestionView.tsx        POST /ingest → pipeline → Annex A03 review
      BatchRecord.tsx          getBatch + getMasterParameters; lineage + provenance table
      DocumentGenerator.tsx    iCoA/CoQ switch; iCoA scope from /parameters default_source; guard
      CertRegister.tsx         listRegister (RegisterEntry); type/status/search filters
      OOSView.tsx              listOos; CoQ-blocked banner
      Laboratories.tsx         listLabs (LabInstitution)
      Templates.tsx            Template Manager (LIVE): upload/version/activate/preview
      Placeholder.tsx          Parameter DB + Settings stubs
```

## Live vs mocked

- **LIVE:** `/health` `/specs` `/parameters` `/dashboard/summary` `/batches` `/batches/{n}`
  `/batches/{n}/master-parameters` `/register` `/oos` `/labs` `/templates` (+`/{doc_type}`, POST upload)
- **Mocked (one-line swap in `api/documents.ts`):** Document Generator `previewDocument` /
  `issueDocument` → bind to `POST /{coq|icoa}/preview` + `/issue` when the engine ships them.
  Ingestion's A03 accept → `GET /checklists/a03/{docId}`.

## DoD (handshake §8)

- [x] TSX; types imported from `src/types/models.ts` (engine-generated)
- [x] Tokens-only Variation F; no `EU GMP` string (MK-GMP); GMP/SOP copy
- [x] Live data + empty/loading/error states; no invented numbers/limits/labs
- [x] Keyboard-navigable; desktop density (13px base, ~36px rows)
- [ ] `tsc + vite build` — runs on commit (the only step the design lane can't run here)

## Open asks for the engine lane

1. Confirm `POST /{coq|icoa}/preview` + `/issue` request/response (does preview return rendered HTML?).
2. Confirm `BatchSummary`/`Batch`/`OOSItem` `status` string vocabularies so `status.ts` maps exactly.
3. Register the final iCoA HTML as the active `icoa` template + wire its mandatory-token validation.
